elements.label: Impact and Bucket column headers (Impact column widens from clipped 'pact' to full width)
Impact rating dots revealed as the column widens
Competitive score cell: slider commits to a number
elements.change_other: slider control replaced by its committed numeric value

pattern.description: Screen recording: the ideas table horizontally re-lays out so the clipped Impact column opens to full width, pushing Bucket, Delivery progress and the competitive columns right; the slider edited in the previous beat settles to a number.
pattern.why_premium: Every column moves together as one reflow, so the viewer reads the full prioritisation grid (impact, bucket, progress, score) at once just before the narration moves on ('Now ideas are...').

build_hint.gsap: Use Flip: capture column state, widen the Impact column, Flip.from(state, {duration:0.17, ease:'power2.out'}) so headers, chips and bars translate x together (no stagger); Impact dots revealed with clipPath inset right 100% -> 0 in the same tween; score cell crossfade slider -> '87' (autoAlpha, 0.1s).
build_hint.remotion: Single progress p = interpolate(frame,[0,5],[0,1],{easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); impact column width = interpolate(p,[0,1],[w0,w1]); downstream columns translateX = (w1-w0)*p; score cell opacity swap at p=1.

notes: Very short burst (~5 frames) in a live screen recording; the reflow may be a scroll/resize rather than an authored animation. The competitive value reads 87 although e025 showed a 75 tooltip during drag.
